## 4. Counterfactual (offline)

Population: the last standstill behind a lead before any event in scenes where the human ends still or ... restricted to stops from motion (ego > 1 m/s 2 s before) where the human ends still and the rule does not already predict a rear-hit (51 scene-reads). Rule check on the current reads (all last standstills, human still or lead at rest): predicted & rear-hit 23, predicted only 7, rear-hit only 4, neither 80. Under stop distance X the ego rests where the standstill reading first drops below X: true gap GX = {4.0: 4.5, 5.0: 5.5, 6.0: 6.8} (+- 0.7 m as low / high); shift = max(0, GX - ego min gap); a new rear-hit when a logged follower exists and the new station is more than (follower gap - 0.5 m) behind the human's rest point, scene not already rear-hit; cost 0.384 per new rear-hit.
